column2: [intro]
Joe Dassin, he's my idol, I admire him so,
When I listen to his tunes, I feel like I’m aglow.
His legendary songs lift me up to the skies,
With his charming voice, he takes me away from the noise.
I love Joe Dassin, he makes me dance with glee,
His joyful melodies, I can’t help but decree.
I love Joe Dassin, his talent’s grand and true,
He filled our hearts with joy and hope anew.
His words can make us laugh, and sometimes even cry,
Joe Dassin, the king of variety, reaching high.
Our evenings turn to celebrations with every song,
He takes us on journeys to lands both strange and strong.
I love Joe Dassin, he makes me dance with glee,
His joyful melodies, I can’t help but decree.
I love Joe Dassin, his talent’s grand and true,
He filled our hearts with joy and hope anew.
